tei:div.tei:p: "!#'um̐ḥ klong chen snying gi thig le lasaḥ nang sgrub rig 'dzin 'dus pa bzhugasaḥ

badz+ra gu ru bid+yā dhā ra yeḥ nang sgrub rig 'dzin 'dus pa niḥ dben zhing nyams dga' sa phyogs dmaraḥ rtsi shing nags tshal me tog rgyasaḥ bkra shis yid 'ong gnas mchog deraḥ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yo byad dngaḥ spyan gzigs la sogs blo dang sbyaraḥ bde ba'i stan la bag phab nasaḥ sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba yiḥ rten 'brel zab mos nyams su blangaḥ sa ma yaḥ dang po sngon 'gro'i sbyor ba laḥ rnam grangs bdun las dang po niḥ mdun mkhar tshogs zhing gsal btab steḥ khyed shes dad pas skyabs su 'groḥ na moḥ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kunaḥ mchog gsum ngo bo bla ma dngaḥ rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor laḥ snying nas dad pas skyabs su mchiḥ lan gsum gnyis pa sems bskyed niḥ hoḥ rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs nasaḥ pha ma 'gro drug sems can kunaḥ tshad med snying rjes sgrol ba'i phyiraḥ smon 'jug don dam byang sems bskyedaḥ lan gsum gsum pa tshogs gsog niḥ hoḥ chu las chu bur ji bzhin duḥ ye shes dbyings las sprul pa'i lharaḥ mngon sum rig pas phyag 'tshal loḥ nyams snang gong 'phel mchod par 'bulaḥ rig pa tshad phebs ngang du bshagasaḥ chos nyid zad la rjes yi rangaḥ 'pho chen klong nas chos 'khor bskoraḥ 'ja' lus chen por bzhugs gsol 'debasaḥ dge tshogs gzhon nu bum skur bsngoḥ bzhi pa bgegs la bka' bsgo baḥ hrīḥ snod bcud sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ glags blta bar gcod bdud kyi rigasaḥ gtor ma longs la gzhan du dengasaḥ bka' las 'da' na rdo rjes gzhomaḥ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang thun gyis gziraḥ lnga pa srung 'khor bsgom pa niḥ hrīḥ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams laḥ bgegs dang bar gcod ming yang medaḥ glo bur rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i gdonaḥ chos dbyings ngang du mtshams gcad doḥ drug pa ye shes byin 'beb niḥ hūm̐ḥ spros bral chos sku'i pho brang nasaḥ dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzangaḥ rigs lnga yab yum sprul 'khor bcasaḥ

dgongs brgyud bla mas byin chen phobaḥ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i pho brang nasaḥ dga' rab 'jam dpal shrī sing sogasaḥ brda brgyud bla mas byin chen phobaḥ 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i pho brang nasaḥ rigs 'dzin brgyad dang pad+ma 'byungaḥ rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga sogasaḥ snyan brgyud bla mas byin chen phobaḥ dkyil 'khor 'di la bkrag cig thonaḥ sgrub rdzas 'di la zhag cig skyilaḥ lus ngag yid la bde chen sporaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsolaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥbid+yā dhā ra e a ral+li phaiṃ phaiṃḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ zhes brjod rol mo drag tu dkrolaḥ bdun pa mchod rdzas byin rlob niḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ snang srid thams cad mchod pa'i sprinaḥ ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pasaḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas kunaḥ kun bzang rnam 'phrul chen por gyuraḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogasaḥ sarba pañtsa rak+ta ba lin+ta ma hā su kha pū tsa āḥhūm̐ḥ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabaḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhir rnam grangs bdunaḥ dang po rten dang brten par bcasaḥ spros bral ngang nas bskyed pa niḥ hūm̐ḥ ma bcos rig pa stong gsal ngangaḥ lhag mthong snang cha'i rten 'brel kunaḥ lhun grub dag pa rab 'byams kyiḥ dkyil 'khor chen por lhun rdzogs pa'iḥ pho brang gzhal med nyams dga' baḥ gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid ldanaḥ brda don rtags gsum yongs rdzogs pa'iḥ phyi nang zang thal chen po'i dbusaḥ sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i stengaḥ hūm̐ las skad cig dran rdzogs suḥ bdag nyid sangs rgyas kun gyi dngosaḥ snang srid zil gnon pad+ma 'byungaḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dkar dmar mdangasaḥ theg gsum rdzogs pa'i brda rtags suḥ phod kha chos gos ber 'dung mnabasaḥ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga bsdigasaḥ g.yon pas bhan+dha tshe bum bsnamasaḥ mchan khung g.yon na lha lcam mdzesaḥ dbu la pad+ma'i mnyen zhu gsolaḥ rgyal po rol pa'i stabs su 'gyingasaḥ

dbu gtsug 'ja' zer thig le'i klongaḥ dga' rab rdo rje longs sku'i chasaḥ dkar gsal rdor dril thugs kar bsnolaḥ de yi dbu gtsug thog ma'i mgonaḥ kun bzang yab yum nam mkha'i mdogaḥ phyi 'khor pad+ma 'dab brgyad stengaḥ 'od lnga'i thig le zlum skor dbusaḥ dpal chen grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyadaḥ kun kyang he ru ka pa'i chasaḥ phyag gnyis ḍā ru dril bu 'khrolaḥ stangs stabs phyag rgya gar gyis rolaḥ phyogs bzhi phyogs mdog mtshams bzhi mthingaḥ sgrub sde brgyad kyi ngo bor gsalaḥ bar mtshams rgya bod rig 'dzin dngaḥ sprul pa'i rje 'bangs nyi shu lngaḥ rnam 'gyur cha lugs ma nges shingaḥ rdo rje'i gar stabs cir yang bsgyuraḥ steng phyogs rgyud sde bzhi drug giḥ yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogasaḥ til gyi gong bu lta bur bzhugasaḥ phyi khyams dpal mgon bdun cu dngaḥ dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad sogasaḥ bka' sdod dam can rlung ltar 'tshubasaḥ sgo bzhir ging chen sde bzhi gsalaḥ kun kyang snang stong rol pa'i ngangaḥ gsal la ma 'dres lhun gyis grubaḥ gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshanaḥ rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor grubaḥ de las 'od zer rab 'phros pasaḥ rang bzhin chos dbyings gnas mchog dngaḥ nub phyogs o rgyan sprul pa'i zhingaḥ gnas yul dur khrod brgyad sogs dngaḥ khyad par rnga yab laṅka'i glingaḥ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nasaḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lhaḥ spyan 'dren gnas 'dir sa mā dzaḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren spos rol dngaḥ gdung ba drag po'i dbyangs kyis 'bodaḥ hūm̐ḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po laḥ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshamasaḥ pad+ma ge sar sdong po laḥ ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyesaḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su gragasaḥ 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang po dngaḥ rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtshos bskoraḥ khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyisaḥ byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsolaḥ gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob laḥ

sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skuraḥ bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad solaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsolaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba niḥ hūm̐ḥ thabs kyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ shes rab dbyings nas drangs pa'i lhaḥ rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor rnamasaḥ gnyis med ngang du dgyes par bzhugasaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ bzhi pa brda phyag 'tshal ba niḥ hūm̐ḥ lha nyid rang la rang nyid lhaḥ rang byung sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor laḥ bzang ngan blang dor ma mchis kyangaḥ rten 'brel brda yis phyag 'tshal loḥ i ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa'i bye brag niḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ phyi nang snod bcud mchod pa'i sprinaḥ nyer spyod 'dod yon sna lnga dngaḥ bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdunaḥ sman gtor rak+ta dang re sproḥ sgeg bzhad g.yo ba'i gar ma dngaḥ bde chen sbyor ba'i rig ma 'bumaḥ mchod bya mchod byed mchod yul kunaḥ ye shes dbyings su rnam dag pa'iḥ mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po sogasaḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha la 'bulaḥ bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nasaḥ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she ā hūm̐ḥ sarba pañtsa ba lin+ta rak+ta ma hā su kha dharma dhā tu āḥhūm̐ḥ drug pa bstod pa bya ba niḥ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi skuḥ bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rjeḥ pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i skuḥ sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ bde byed brtsegs par zab rgya'i dngos grub brnyesaḥ dur khrod brgyad du dgongs pa'i btsan sa zinaḥ rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtshor mnga' dbang bsgyuraḥ mchog gi rig 'dzin brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ dgongs pa klong chen yangs pa'i mkha' la 'phyoḥ rnam 'gyur brtul zhugs spyod pas 'gro ba 'drenaḥ rmad byung rdo rje snying po'i dgongs srog 'dzinaḥ

thugs sras rje 'bangs nyer lngar phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ gzhan yang rig 'dzin sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor duḥ dam tshig thugs rjes 'khod pa'i rtsa gsum lhaḥ ye shes dbyings las sprul pa'i pho nya baḥ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ bdun pa 'dzab dgongs gsal ba niḥ thugs kar pad+ma nyi zla'i stengaḥ hūm̐ yig mthing ga'i mtha' skor duḥ sngags phreng spu shad lta bus bskoraḥ 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud sbyangasaḥ rnam dag lha yi dal du bsgomaḥ ma 'grub bar du mi gtang ngoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ bsnyen pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bskyalaḥ res 'ga' hūm̐ gi snang glu lenaḥ shes pa gtad med ngang la btangaḥ rjes thob lu gu rgyud la gziraḥ 'di nyid sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor laḥ rig 'dzin rgya mtshos byin gyis brlabaḥ ma dang ḍā kis lung yang stonaḥ phyi ma rnga yab dpal gyi riraḥ the tshom med do sa ma yaḥ gab byang lasaḥ bsnyen pa 'bru 'bum sngon song nasaḥ rig 'dzin srog sgrub snying po niḥ thog mtha' oṃ dang hūm̐ bzhag nasaḥ bar na bcu gnyis grong mdzes paḥ rig 'dzin srog gi yang snying yinaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dngos grub thobaḥ ces gsungs soḥ rjes la tshogs kyi rim pa niḥ srid pa'i 'dod yon mchod par bshamaḥ khyad par sha chang med mi rungaḥ dang po byin gyis rlob pa niḥ hūm̐ḥ bdag nyid thugs las raṃ yaṃ khaṃḥ 'phros pas tshogs kyi nyes skyon sbyangasaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyuraḥ 'dod yon nam mkha' mnyam par spelaḥ raṃ yaṃ khaṃḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren niḥ hūm̐ḥ 'og min bde chen zhing khams dngaḥ nub phyogs o rgyan sprul pa'i glingaḥ khyad par rnga yab dpal gyi riḥ gnas yul dur khrod brgyad sogs nasaḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnamasaḥ tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsolaḥ dur khrod tshogs khang nyams re dga'aḥ

mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba bag re droḥ rnal 'byor pho mo dam re gtsangaḥ 'dod yon tshogs mchod mdangs dang ldanaḥ 'dir gshegs tshogs la byin chen phobaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsolaḥ gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba niḥ hūm̐ḥ rtsa gsum rig 'dzin rgya mtsho dngaḥ ḍā ki chos srung dam can laḥ 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs mchod 'bulaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsolaḥ ga ṇa tsakra pū tsa khā hiḥ bzhi pa bar pa bshags pa niḥ hūm̐ḥ bdag gi tshe rabs thog med nasaḥ gsang sngags theg chen sgor zhugs teḥ rtsa ba yan lag dam nyams paḥ 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshagasaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya aḥ lnga pa bsgral zhing bstab pa niḥ hūm̐ḥ ma rig las nyon gzung 'dzin gyisaḥ bskyed pa'i bdag 'dzin rū tra kunaḥ gzugs la phob cig nṛ tri dzaḥ rnam shes chos dbyings klong du phaṭaḥ gzugs phung tshogs kyi 'khor lor rolaḥ rū tra sarba ha la pañtsa pū tsa khā hiḥ drug pa lhag ma bsngo ba niḥ hūm̐ḥ dkyil 'khor chen po'i mu ran laḥ gnas pa'i dbang phyug ging laṅkaḥ lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i bar chad srungasaḥ ush+tsiṃṣ+ṭa bha ling+ta khā hiḥ bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba niḥ hūm̐ḥ bzhengs shig rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lhaḥ chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs laḥ byang chub bsgrub pa'i bar chad thulaḥ snod bcud 'byung ba'i rgud pa solaḥ rtsa rlung dbang thang nyams pa gsosaḥ sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzodaḥ brgyad pa chad tho bya ba niḥ hūm̐ḥ sngon tshe 'og min bde chen zhingaḥ lha gnas gsum sogs nyams dga' b.raḥ gsang chen rgyud sde'i gnas bstan tsheḥ rdo rje theg pa'i bka' srung rnamasaḥ dam tshig gnyan po'i gral du bzhagaḥ bar du gangs can bod kyi yulaḥ slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gisaḥ gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor ba'i tsheḥ srid pa'i lha srin che dgu yiḥ srog snying phrogs te rtsis su phabaḥ tha ma 'od gsal dag pa'i zhingaḥ bde ba chen po'i pho brang duḥ

rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang chen laḥ pad 'byung dri med 'od zer gyisaḥ klong chen zab rgya'i dbugs dbyung zhingaḥ ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro masaḥ klong gsal brda ris sprad pa'i tsheḥ gza' rgod srog gi spu gri sogasaḥ bka' srung gnyan pos khas blangs bzhinaḥ mchod gtor rgyan ldan 'di bzhes laḥ las bzhi'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzodaḥ dgu pa brtan ma skyong ba niḥ hūm̐ḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan bod khams skyongaḥ ma sring brtan ma bcu gnyis rnamasaḥ 'dir byon gtor ma'i bshal chu bzhesaḥ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ ma ma hriṃ hriṃ bha lin+ta khā hiḥ bcu pa rta bro bya ba niḥ hūm̐ḥ rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ log par 'dren pa'i dam sri kunaḥ mnan no theg pa rim dgu'i rgyaḥ nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cigaḥ staṃ bha ya nanaḥ bcu gcig dngos grub blang ba niḥ hoḥ rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnamasaḥ bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i dam tshig themasaḥ rdo rje sems dpa'i nam yang langasaḥ dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babaḥ sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nasaḥ mi gnas ye shes gsang ba mchogaḥ rdo rje gsum gyis byin rlobs laḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kunaḥ da lta nyid du thob par stsolaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a la la sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ḥ bcu gnyis nongs pa bshags pa niḥ hūm̐ḥ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor duḥ mchod rdzas ma tshang sgrub pa g.yelaḥ ting 'dzin bying rmugs 'thibs la sogasaḥ 'gal 'khrul nongs pa bzod par gsolaḥ oṃ badz+ra satwa sogs brjodaḥ bcu gsum rdzogs rim bsdu ba niḥ hoḥ chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhinaḥ rang las sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor lhaḥ ye shes dbyings su badz+ra muḥ rjes thob sgyu ma'i lha skur ldangaḥ bcu bzhi bsngo smon mtshams sbyor niḥ hoḥ dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa kunaḥ rnam mkhyen gdod ma'i rgyu ru bsngoḥ

bdag sogs 'dus par bcas pa rnamasaḥ tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas shogaḥ lan gsumaḥ bco lnga bkra shis brjod pa niḥ hoḥ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dngaḥ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dngaḥ gsang sngags zab mo'i rten 'brel gyisaḥ 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i bkra shis shogaḥ tshe bsod rgyas pa'i bkra shis shogaḥ snang ba dbang 'dus bkra shis shogaḥ log 'dren tshar gcod bkra shis shogaḥ snang zhen lha sku'i phyag rgyar rdzogasaḥ sgra grags bde chen sngags su dgaḥ dran rtog 'od gsal chos skur sminaḥ 'ja' lus zang thal bkra shis shogaḥ e maḥ 'di ltar shin tu zab pa'i gnadaḥ gter bcud 'dus pa dgongs pa'i gteraḥ klong gsal dbyings kyi pho brang duḥ brda tshig rdo rje'i rol mor 'khrolaḥ snying la rgyas btab sba snyam yangaḥ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i brdas bskul nasaḥ las can rjes 'jug don du bkodaḥ snying la sbos shig sa ma yaḥ
